flash.$description: The tint flash that signals a change.

spin.$description: One turn of the spinner a busy button, chip, loading line, link state or palette row prints.

card.$description: A card or toast easing in.

veil.$description: The veil easing in behind a dialog.

pop.$description: A row's check popping as it is checked.

press.$description: A button or a decision tile shrinking as it is pressed.
